name: Nabukelevu
bio_draft: mountain: 805 m inactive volcano and highest point of Kadavu, known as Mount Washington

name: Navala Village
bio_draft: Village: traditional bure village inland from Ba, where visitors stay in basic homestays; the source is Wikipedia only, a tourism source still needed.

name: Mount Tomanivi
bio_draft: Peak: Fiji's highest point (1,324 m) in the interior of Viti Levu; a climb rather than a managed attraction, no visitor source checked yet. Coordinates lie in the north-west highlands; check which region judges it.

name: Vanua Balavu
bio_draft: Island in the northern Lau Group, one of the two main visitor islands with homestays, a guesthouse, Lomaloma port and the Bay of Islands; reached by domestic flight or charter.

name: Bay of Islands, Vanua Balavu
bio_draft: Natural bay of islets and a limestone cathedral cave with snorkelling, on the northern tip of Vanua Balavu; Wikipedia's Vanua Balavu article gives its other name as Qilaqila, a marine reserve (permission to anchor needed). Reached by yacht, seaplane or charter.

name: Lakeba
bio_draft: Island in the southern Lau Group, the administrative and population centre with a weekly flight, homestays and caves, hillforts and Tongan-influenced villages; reached by air or boat.
